severityDefinitions.high: Could invalidate safety/scientific or compliance claims; prevents operational acceptance.
severityDefinitions.medium: Material engineering or verification gap; explicit scope limits required.
severityDefinitions.low: Presentation/design preference, maintainability or intended architecture gap without changed scientific calculations.

items.problem: The scientific correctness of LLM interpretation has not been independently validated. A sample cache showed a weak inference from smoke-mixture findings to cool-flame behavior.
items.mitigation: Source/hypothesis/inference boundaries are visible; no safety score or intervention order. No operational use before an expert comparison set and claim-evidence audit are developed.

items.problem: A Class C target is not formal classification, software assurance, independent review or NASA approval.
items.mitigation: The 92 applicable marked rows remain open/partial; no approval or tailoring is claimed. Intended use/safety-criticality must be reviewed against NASA-STD-8739.8.

items.problem: Deep static analysis, code-coverage measurements, independent peer review and accreditation of development tools are not yet available.
items.mitigation: Local automated and EXE smoke tests exist; they do not substitute for the missing activities.

items.problem: No clean second-Windows-device test or digital signature. Operating-system dependencies include Windows PowerShell/DPAPI and a browser.
items.mitigation: Relocated-EXE and empty-PATH testing on the same machine; no separate installation/launcher; second-device acceptance is planned.

items.problem: The dataset package supports file access; AI interprets only the selected 24 metadata/11 supporting web records. Full PDF/Excel text and numerical conditions have not all been normalized.
items.mitigation: Scope is explicit in the UI/documentation; files can be opened manually, and unsupported table findings are not generated. The 67 missing/excluded sources and 2269 role reviews are retained.

items.problem: NPR cost/schedule/training/organizational delivery and acceptance records have not yet been provided.
items.mitigation: Preserve the user's product-plan preference without people/durations; do not remove those NPR evidence requirements and count them as satisfied. Complete them through a separate management process.

items.problem: A malicious process under the same Windows user can bypass the benefit of DPAPI protection; model-service and Windows-runtime changes are external dependencies.
items.mitigation: Do not share the user profile; bind the local server to loopback; redact logs; change the model only by explicit decision. Do not guarantee operating-system security.

items.problem: The Rust target is not implemented yet; the current demo uses Node SEA.
items.mitigation: State the actual language/architecture clearly in README; handle Rust migration as a separately tested release.

items.problem: Not every file in a package folder is read at startup; if extraction is incomplete, an error appears when the affected file is accessed.
items.mitigation: Verify every distribution ZIP member by CRC/SHA readback; verify index SHA at startup and file SHA/size on access. Incomplete extraction cannot be repaired automatically.

items.problem: Windows Node 25.9 synchronous gunzip intermittently returned incorrect data check on the large catalog; the asynchronous path succeeded with identical bytes/hash.
items.mitigation: Asynchronous gunzip with a copied buffer and a 64 MiB decompression limit; 15 full-catalog loads and final-EXE loading passed. A platform-wide root cause has not been established.

items.problem: Validated numerical conditions, weights and thresholds remain unavailable. Topic coverage is not physical similarity or fire risk.
items.mitigation: 0.1.2 replaces keyword percentage on /api/match with per-run numerical closeness and source provenance. 1538 rows from 10 sources normalized partially. Default draft weights total50; no overall score without total100, material compatibility and complete weighted measurements. Academic weighting and critical thresholds remain OPEN.

items.problem: LLM source-only instruction cannot prove every free-form summary grounded. PDF/Excel not automatically extracted; selected small text excerpts are bounded.
items.mitigation: No web/search/tools in provider payload; one fixed Gemini API destination. Exact citations checked; unsupported/conversation replies separate. Context hashes and truncation recorded.

items.problem: Local 20-200 character key alphabet rejected dotted/long opaque keys before Google saw them. User-specific key was not inspected.
items.mitigation: Allow printable opaque header values up to4096; remove surrounding pasted whitespace/quotes; reject internal whitespace/control characters. DPAPI persist/restart tested with fake long dotted key. Provider validity not tested by saving.

items.problem: Numerical closeness is not physical response equivalence. Material family is not grade, coating, blend or flammability equivalence. Ratio distance has no experimental risk calibration.
items.mitigation: Expose formula, per-parameter evidence, missing weight, approximation tags and source row. No critical label or automatic operational action. Keep unparsed ranges and absent gravity/ambient temperature unknown.

items.problem: Trial-average/initial conditions can be confused with stage-synchronized measurements; CSV and PDF can describe the same trial.
items.mitigation: Never average variable flow into a matching scalar; initial O2 labelled whole trial; no stage O2 interpolation; keep source rows distinct without cross-source column merging; report-row count is not unique trials. Hash-pin both calibration and report; material family and specimen kind required for complete percentage.

items.problem: High stretch similarity or local mathematical sensitivity can be mistaken for equivalent burning, ignition probability or validated physical risk weights.
items.mitigation: Separate named methods; require cast PMMA, rod, hemispherical tip, concurrent flow, microgravity declaration and source diameter range. Measured flame radius required for total mode. State oxygen/thermal state absent, curvature omitted for forced mode, diameter mismatch, and three representative author estimates only.

items.problem: Required heat flux can be mistaken for heat actually available from a flame; approximate70% loss discussion can be mistaken for universal extinction threshold.
items.mitigation: No class labels or fire risk weights; keep required-flux, assumed material constants, source illustration range and measured-regression semantics explicit. Independent validation remains needed.

items.problem: Empirical extinction-fit distance or input uncertainty overlap may be mistaken for validated critical ignition/fire risk. Source-fit error and transfer to other conditions are unknown.
items.mitigation: Signed O2 margin instead of headline probability. Source material/state/time gates, unvalidated plot window, unknown model error explicitly excluded, no safety classification. Preserve the printed coefficients despite approximate prose minimum.

items.problem: Nominal versus time-varying O2, no-ignition versus brief ignition, reused specimen state and ambiguous physical trial identities can distort matching and validation.
items.mitigation: Flag two O2 values, omit consumed construction values for reused samples, preserve source wording/discrepancies and all31 source rows; composition/history gates and separate alternative trials. No universal PMMA transfer or safety class.

items.problem: Observed terminal conditions, no-blowoff tests, Pareto ranking or input-box overlap could be mistaken for a calibrated extinction boundary or critical fire classification.
items.mitigation: No interpolated boundary; preserve separate mechanisms and widths, source nominal structure gate, unknown source errors, no-blowoff records excluded from event ranking,12mm boundary unresolved label.

items.problem: No-sustained-flame can be misread as nonflammability; duplicate documents as independent trials; verified instrument calibration as verified specimen velocity.
items.mitigation: Nomex exact product name, brief ignition details and disputed F3 finalO2;3 hash-pinned identity links;24 centerline estimates separated from numeric matching. Ignition exposure, geometry, source equivalence and local calibration validity remain unknown.

items.problem: A nominal proximity score can imply false precision; input-only bounds can be confused with full uncertainty or critical risk.
items.mitigation: Absolute input bounds, analytic extrema, unknown errors never zero, fixed source nominal values explicit, no confidence/risk semantics; source measurement error, covariance and independent model validation still unknown.

items.problem: Comparing experiment summaries can conflate physical runs, mixed inputs and observations with controlled causal evidence or fire probabilities.
items.mitigation: Explicit2-6 run selection; source identity and physical keys where verified; deep saved snapshots; source observations kept separate from numeric closeness. Unknown outcomes are not negative observations; changing flow is not averaged. Controlled-pair identification and independent risk validation remain open.

items.problem: Normalized source-model sensitivities can be misrepresented as universal fire-risk weights; first-order derivatives can falsely imply zero effect at a stationary point.
items.mitigation: Exact one-at-a-time interval extrema, explicit analyst probe, stationary-point handling, separate joint bound and no partial renormalization. Shares are conditional on material/model/base point/step and are not applied to generic similarity. Independent experimental/model-error validation still open.

items.problem: Fuel-family and pressure equality can hide different gas composition, supply arrangement and ignition outcomes.
items.mitigation: Pinned CFI-G stream semantics, positive-weight composition gate, explicit normal/inverse filter and preserved hot/cool/termination observations. Diluent purity, flow, ignition protocol and general fire-risk weights remain unresolved.

items.problem: Equal stoichiometric mixture fraction can arise from different compositions; local derivatives can be mistaken for universal risk weights.
items.mitigation: Explicit nitrogen gate, source formula/hash verification, retained raw compositions and reported Zst, derivative meaning and limitations. Binary model omits vitiation and ignition/flow effects. No fire-risk percentage.

items.problem: Language migration could alter interpretation of source outcomes or mathematical scope.
items.mitigation: AST structural check, 148 current tests, 12 real-data checks, executable checks and English UI review; independent domain review remains open.

items.problem: 60/40 ranking is a user-selected retrieval preference; equal numeric shares and AI scenario rubric are not calibrated fire risk or validated physical equivalence.
items.mitigation: 0.2.8 supersedes the null-total presentation: evidence-backed partial totals, coverage and missing-evidence budget; same-material single-trial comparisons. Numerical weights and scenario relevance remain uncalibrated retrieval preferences. See G028-01.
items.previousMitigation: Separate components; null combined score when required source measurements or material are missing; cite single-trial evidence. Independent validation remains required.

items.problem: Research assistant is not an emergency-response system. Local experiment suppression results may not transfer to a user incident.
items.mitigation: System prompt prioritizes applicable crew/site emergency procedures, no sensor delay, no improvised agent/dose/atmosphere interventions; no emergency efficacy claim.

items.problem: Material autocomplete and discovery context cover normalized rows and bounded indexed metadata, not every PDF or spreadsheet. Live Gemini dialogue/relevance quality is unverified in this release.
items.mitigation: Source provenance, arbitrary text permitted, no absent material invented, source-file follow-up remains available; mocked provider and real portable verification distinguished.

items.problem: An optional untraceable condition suggestion discarded the complete scenario response, including a valid clarification question.
items.mitigation: Optional suggestions are independently filtered with rejection reasons; form entries, zero values and scientific citation gates remain protected. Screenshot conditions reproduced through the actual analyzer with a mocked provider.
items.limitations: The exact live provider response behind the screenshot was not captured; response variants are deterministic fixtures, not new live Gemini evidence.

items.problem: Conversation overwrites last message and has no persistent history.
items.mitigation: Bounded local transcripts, explicit role labels, atomic file writes/backup and optimistic revision; recovery of unsaved old messages is unavailable.

items.problem: Application validation errors can be mistaken for model-authored replies.
items.mitigation: Separate application notices and per-turn provider receipt; cache versus actual request explicit.

items.problem: Retyped model quotations can fail exact matching and suppress research dialogue.
items.mitigation: Model selects server-generated evidence references; source text inserted locally; unknown IDs rejected. No claim of independent semantic validation.

items.problem: Earlier unsaved history is not recoverable; bounded prompt context is shorter than visible saved history. Live semantic relevance of provider responses is not verified.
items.mitigation: History location and limits documented. Current source claims still require evidence. New history is saved outside distribution; no raw failed model output or API key is logged.

items.problem: All-or-nothing numeric evidence hid useful partial scores and confused omitted user inputs with missing source measurements.
items.mitigation: Only provided finite inputs share 60 points equally. Missing source measurements retain null comparisons and earn no evidence points; totals show coverage and missing evidence budget. Scenario-only uses 40 points. No new physical data inferred.

items.problem: Composer retained sent messages; repeated form summaries and serial geometry questions slowed dialogue.
items.mitigation: Immediate clear after storing user turn, no deletion of new drafts. Prompt asks direct response and grouped geometry/storage details. Live model adherence remains unverified.

items.problem: Report excerpts were empty and table/graph references were not directly viewable.
items.mitigation: Local hash-verified PDF pages and text via vendored PDF.js; CSV/TSV cells and common image figures shown inline. Unsupported formats retain original-download links.

items.problem: Research replies reset recommendations rather than maintaining context across turns.
items.mitigation: Validated source-reference keep/replace/clear updates persist per conversation. Invalid candidates are omitted and do not erase existing evidence. Changed input marks previous candidates for review.

items.problem: Equal numerical weights and eight subjective scenario weights are retrieval preferences, not calibrated combustion physics; sources with missing measurements have limited scoring evidence.
items.mitigation: Explicit coverage, missing evidence budget, single-trial provenance and scenario-only denominator. No critical/safe classification or fire probability. Independent scientific validation pending.

items.problem: New chat was hard to find; editing/submitting environment retained the old scenario. Source focus and other workspace state could remain across conversations.
items.mitigation: Always-visible New chat and Chat history; an explicit environment-only new-chat option resets scenario/history/recommendations/source tabs. Current conditions supersede conflicting prior dialogue in the server prompt. Stored history and local credentials retained. Mocked provider boundary checked; real Gemini adherence unverified.

items.problem: BASS-II Figure 6.10 raw point reconstruction is not complete. Test matrices contain repeated runs and multiple event settings; fitted curve coordinates do not establish experimental precision.
items.mitigation: Read-only source review records Equation 6.1, axes, actual Excel/CSV and calibration provenance. No invented measured points. Event-to-reading/calibration mapping and complementary drop-tower source data still required.

items.problem: Graphs were visible only inside full PDF pages; users could not directly inspect published equation values or isolate graph images.
items.mitigation: Reviewed hash-bound figure registry; equation plot, numeric reader and CSV; original graph-only crop with separate caption, zoom and PNG export. Three initial reviewed BASS-II figures.

items.problem: An initial approximate Figure 6.10 crop clipped an axis label and included source caption text.
items.mitigation: Replaced approximate crop with actual PDF embedded-image object bounds plus one-point padding. All three final browser PNGs checked visually and against source geometry.

items.problem: Calculated empirical fits can be mistaken for original measurements or a general safe-fire boundary. Original measured series and uncertainties are not fully mapped.
items.mitigation: Explicit calculated-not-measured labels, reviewed 1–150 inverse-seconds window, source SHA and equation/caption provenance; no invented scatter/error bars or pressure-temperature/fire-probability inference. G029-01 remains open. Existing boundary equation is factored into a shared pure function with fixed expected-value regression tests; coefficients are unchanged.

items.problem: Conversation controls polluted the scientific scenario: The browser appended every message, including the exact language command, to scenario. A nonempty string enabled all local source candidates.
items.mitigation: Shared narrow routing separates language, formatting and greetings from research. Legacy control-only lines are filtered from the bounded scenario without deleting visible transcript. The server recomputes the route and keeps language preference per chat.

items.problem: One validation error concealed several different failures: Scenario required before ranking was thrown for missing/non-array/overlong assessments, missing scenario, or clarify with assessments. HTTP 200 was mistaken for an application success expectation.
items.mitigation: Routed JSON Schema plus separate local branch codes. Non-ranking omitted empty collections are normalized only when harmless. Scientific references, rubrics and ranking lists remain fail-closed. Safe diagnostics record shape, counts, field, route and response digest without raw answer text.

items.problem: Focused-source chat bypassed the environment/scenario workflow: Continue with AI selected the legacy chat handler instead of the research handler. Scenario, language and environment management consequently diverged.
items.mitigation: Both focused and general research conversations use the same planner and endpoint. A valid focused source restricts candidates to that record. Current optional inputs still supersede conflicting history. Specialist comparison retains its separate explicit mode.

items.problem: Meta replies could mark old recommendations current: A keep update cleared the stale flag even when the turn contained no scientific review. A greeting could also clear the active-incident flag.
items.mitigation: The server marks whether a research review occurred. Conversation/clarification replies preserve prior stale state and incident notice; only a validated research review can replace, clear or reconfirm candidates. Changed scientific context invalidates previous recommendations before the request.

items.problem: Response application did not cover source-focus transitions: Environment revision and app/source revision were separate. A delayed answer could outlive a source change, including changing away and back.
items.mitigation: Response acceptance checks environment revision, app revision and source identity. A stale response is retained in the transcript with its own notice but cannot update current rankings or recommendations. A newly typed draft remains untouched.

items.problem: Conversation capacity could fail after sending the final user message: At 499 stored messages the user turn occupied the last slot, leaving no room for a provider answer or error notice. An exception outside cleanup could leave UI controls locked.
items.mitigation: A turn preflight reserves two slots before sending. Stale-answer warnings are stored inside the response rather than consuming a third message. Both chat paths unlock in finally and isolate status-refresh errors.

items.problem: Receipt/cache filesystem failure could masquerade as model rejection: Writing optional logs or cache inside the success path could throw after a valid provider answer. Subsequent logging could hide the original error again.
items.mitigation: Nonessential telemetry/cache failures are contained and counted. A valid answer remains visible with a local-storage warning; history persistence has a separate visible status. There is no silent claim that storage succeeded.

items.problem: Protocol errors were misleading or too generic: All provider HTTP 400/401/403 responses suggested key/access trouble. Invalid JSON request bodies or non-JSON local responses could produce unrelated exceptions.
items.mitigation: HTTP 400 reports request-format rejection, 401/403 authentication/access. Incomplete output and invalid JSON have distinct codes; malformed local request shapes receive 400. Local transport failures have application-specific messages. No automatic retry or model fallback.

items.problem: Generated submission text and unrelated laboratory fields entered dialogue context: The generated Environment submitted label entered model history; default burner-specific condition keys/units also accompanied environmental research.
items.mitigation: Generated submit labels are excluded from model history. Research payloads include only material and the six supported optional environmental measurements with their units. Specialist mode remains available and unchanged.

items.problem: Control turns discarded visible research results: Sending any chat message cleared research results before the reply. This made language or formatting changes look like loss of scientific work.
items.mitigation: Non-research controls preserve current matching results and recommendation state. Source-focused conversation retains general matching results unless the environment itself changes.

items.problem: Controlled local tests cannot establish every natural-language intent, scientific conclusion or live provider schema acceptance.
items.mitigation: Live Gemini acceptance of the updated schema and qualitative answer quality have not been tested in this release. All provider responses in verification are mocked; no user quota was spent. The deterministic control recognizer is intentionally narrow. Mixed scientific messages and unknown phrasing remain research; readiness still depends on the model returning clarify or rank. Schema, exact quotation and rubric validation establish format/reference traceability, not scientific truth or suitability for an active fire. Research discovery still uses bounded indexed local metadata/supporting text, not every PDF/table. Numeric coverage gaps remain visible; no score-weight or physical-equation changes.

items.problem: The existing total history size and chat count limits require a future archive/export workflow. Full storage preserves the previous file but newer visible session content may remain unsaved.
items.mitigation: Visible persistence notices, atomic store and revision checks remain; per-turn message capacity is now checked before provider work.

items.problem: The actual local provider receipt records HTTP 400 with only Request contains an invalid argument. The 0.3.1 release introduced a nested responseJsonSchema with array/numeric bounds and unions; Google documents that schema complexity can cause 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT. This is a plausible regression source, not a proven rejection field.
items.mitigation: Restore JSON MIME mode without a provider-compiled schema. Preserve authoritative routing, the explicit output contract, local shape/rubric/citation validation, no tools, same model and no automatic retries. Invalidate prior prompt cache with a new contract version.

items.problem: The recognizer accepted cevap verebilir misin but not cevap verir misin. The failed receipt confirms research intent with 35 candidate sources. The defect is confirmed independently of the provider rejection.
items.mitigation: Recognize bounded polite language-only forms, including the exact reported sentence. Preserve mixed scientific questions as research. Both browser and server use the shared route; contaminated control-only scenario lines are filtered while transcript and actual scenario remain.

items.problem: The recorded message was generic and lacked provider status/field paths or a digest of the sent contract. The precise rejected argument could not be established from that record.
items.mitigation: Record JSON contract, MIME, schema-presence flags, byte count and SHA-256 without storing request content. Preserve allowlisted provider status and sanitized BadRequest field paths if supplied. Never infer a field when none is supplied; do not retain arbitrary provider detail bodies.

items.problem: One authorized language-only request passed live HTTP 200 and local validation. Research/ranking and multi-turn semantic performance remain untested live; the original 400 field is unspecified.
items.mitigation: Retain strict scientific validators and no retries. Keep the successful single-call receipt with its exact EXE hash; do not extend this proof to all source-bearing requests.

items.problem: The prompt required reasons only for intermediate scores and used an ambiguous rubricReasons placeholder; the validator required nonempty explanations for every dimension, including zero and anchor scores.
items.mitigation: List all eight explanation keys explicitly and require 1-600 characters for every dimension. Keep the existing numeric rubric values and 60/40 scoring policy.

items.problem: RESEARCH_RUBRIC_REASON threw from inside the per-source loop, losing the conversation and otherwise valid peers after a successful provider response.
items.mitigation: After mandatory source and numeric validation, quarantine only assessments with unexplained positive scores into an unscored list. Preserve source links, verified quotes, dialogue and valid peer scores. Zero-point missing reasons receive an administrative note without changing a number or inventing a scientific rationale.

items.problem: The previous pipeline exposed only all-passed or all-rejected and logged the collection field, without the affected source or dimension. Revalidating sanitized partial responses from cache could lose the scoring warning.
items.mitigation: Return partial validation receipts and per-source/per-dimension bounded diagnostics. Display the scoring limitation in chat and source cards. Preserve stale recommendation state during partial reviews. Do not cache recovered assessments; normal complete replies keep caching. Persist partial responses in chat history.

items.problem: Provider success on a language request does not validate source-bearing research. Local fixtures establish recovery behavior, not live scientific answer quality.
items.mitigation: The original rejected raw answer was not retained. The precise missing/empty/invalid/overlong dimension cannot be reconstructed; code inspection proves the prompt/validator mismatch and whole-response failure behavior. No live provider call is authorized for this patch yet. The previous 0.3.2 live test covered only a language request; it is not evidence for this scientific scenario. A valid quote and explanation establish traceability, not scientific correctness. Unscored sources receive no numerical total and are not inserted into the sorted scored list. Partial scoring keeps previous recommendations unchanged/stale pending a complete review. Other invalid source references, quotes, rubric values, duplicate sources or envelope fields still reject the response; this is a bounded correction, not universal recovery. No dataset, formula, weights, private API key or private transcript was changed. Node SEA remains the runtime; NPR 7150.2D Class C remains an incomplete engineering target, not certification.

items.problem: The saved HTTP 200 receipt records stage=rank, two assessments and keep with two recommendation items. The old validator threw ANALYSIS_INVALID for this contradictory optional update, losing the whole reply. The prompt did not explicitly spell out the empty-list requirement for keep and clear.
items.mitigation: Use one shared explicit keep/clear/replace contract in both prompt modes. Contain malformed or conflicting recommendation updates as a non-applied partial update. Preserve valid conversation, source assessments and numerical scores without inferring the intended operation.

items.problem: Simply dropping invalid items or coercing keep/clear into replace could discard earlier candidates or apply unsupported content. The research validator previously marked every ranking reply as recommendationsReviewed even if no optional update was supplied. A normalized absent section could become a false completed review on cache revalidation.
items.mitigation: Keep replacements atomic: if any item fails its source/quote/content checks, apply none of that update. Keep earlier recommendation and emergency state, with the UI retaining stale status after changed context. Compute review flags on the server; preserve omission as omission across cache validation. Non-ranking turns cannot refresh recommendations.

items.problem: The prior pipeline exposed the failure as a rejected answer and had no isolated recommendation warning. Caching a sanitized recovery could later turn its keep operation into an apparently complete review.
items.mitigation: Show a Recommendation update not applied notice, mark the receipt partial, retain bounded action/count/issue diagnostics in the receipt and history, and exclude recovered replies from the answer cache. Normal complete answers retain caching; no automatic retry is added.

items.problem: The new containment has not been tested with a fresh live source-bearing Gemini response. Structural validation is not semantic scientific validation.
items.mitigation: The rejected raw response was not retained. The saved response shape proves keep plus two items, but the items and their scientific support cannot be reconstructed. Controlled fixtures reproduce this operation conflict, not the unseen exact response. No live Gemini request was made for this release. The prior 0.3.2 language-only trial is not evidence for this research correction. Fresh live research validation and independent semantic review remain open. Mandatory research envelope, source, citation, duplicate-source and numeric-rubric checks still reject invalid research. Partial recovery does not invent scores, repair scientific claims or convert keep/clear to replace. Source-supported candidates remain research/design aids, not validated emergency instructions. A verified quotation is not proof of a recommendation's semantic correctness. No dataset, physical equation, score weight, model or private credential was changed. Node SEA remains the runtime; NASA NPR 7150.2D Class C remains an incomplete engineering target, not certification.

items.problem: Research scoring required a nonempty exact material name before comparing any condition. A fiberglass form or empty material therefore discarded all available oxygen/pressure/flow rows, including relevant contextual experiments.
items.mitigation: Compare environmental measurements independently, identify source material explicitly, and require same material family for specimen thickness. Keep the existing six-input budget, arithmetic proximity formula and single-row integrity. Cross-material proximity is contextual, not equivalent burning.

items.problem: Unavailable normalized source measurements displayed 0/60. Discovery supplied only bounded metadata and no reviewed series/figure index; users could not distinguish a missing point comparison from a useful material study.
items.mitigation: Distinguish not_requested/unavailable/partial/complete conditions. Preserve all assessed sources and display source usefulness independently of point proximity. Add material-separated measured spans with row provenance and reviewed graphs, plus coverage evidence in the model context. Do not infer joint coverage, outcomes or interpolation from marginal ranges.

items.problem: Equal parameter weights and min/max ratios are retrieval arithmetic; they do not establish output-specific tolerances, material equivalence or invariance of burning across environment changes.
items.mitigation: Expose independent source usefulness, numeric proximity and reviewed physical-model applicability. Include verified PMMA stretch and energy-balance source definitions/properties without transferring them to other materials. Retrieve by material/mechanism first, then assess transport/regime transfer. Unknown tolerance never excludes a source or becomes an invented 99% score.

items.problem: The new discovery/coverage instructions have not been tested with a fresh live source-bearing Gemini response. Software verification is not semantic scientific validation.
items.mitigation: Read-only audit: 1592 normalized source rows from 10 of 35 catalog records. No normalized numerical gravity or ambient-temperature column is currently available. This is a normalization scope limit, not proof that these values do not exist somewhere in the full documents. The 60/40 budget and raw proximity formula are editorial retrieval calculations, not physical laws or calibrated combustion similarity. Usefulness is a separate evidence category. A missing temperature model is not converted to either zero physical similarity or an invented 99%. A marginal span does not prove joint experimental coverage or an interpolatable surface. No generic flame/ignition interpolation or extrapolation is introduced. Same material family does not certify grade, moisture, geometry or storage equivalence. Reviewed quantitative physics is currently limited to the existing hash-pinned cast-PMMA rod sources. Required heat flux and stretch proximity are not ignition/extinction predictions. Paper/cellulose-specific physical tolerance calibration remains open. Third-party candidates were researched after explicit user authorization. They are recorded separately with provenance/license status; no external experimental payload was imported into the fixed dataset or production AI context. No new live Gemini request was made. Local and browser fixtures verify software behavior, not live scientific answer quality. No private key or transcript was read or packaged. Node SEA remains the runtime. NPR 7150.2D Class C remains an incomplete engineering target.

items.problem: Removing a long table/PDF preview for a short status or native-format message changed document height and allowed the browser to clamp the outer scroll. File lookup and preview also shared one invalidation counter.
items.mitigation: Keep stable independent list and preview panes, a non-collapsing status line and persistent controls. Replace only preview content, preserve pane position where possible, and separate list/preview generations. Ignore stale PDF errors.

items.problem: The file-kind filter had only tables, PDFs and images; reviewed regeneratable figures were hidden inside a report and not selectable as separate entries.
items.mitigation: Add Plotted graphics with one entry per reviewed reproducible figure, keyed by exact source hash. Exclude original-only images and unreviewed spreadsheets. Reuse the loaded PDF when switching its reviewed figures.

items.problem: Pointer movement updated the equation table/readout, but the chart did not identify the nearest visible curve at the pointer with a local tooltip.
items.mitigation: Evaluate the reviewed equation at pointer x, hit-test only visible in-window curves, and show series, x, y and calculation provenance. Keep original-only graphs nonnumerical; four decimals are calculation digits, not measurement accuracy.

items.problem: Only a small exact-source-reviewed graph set is regenerated; other images and workbook charts are not automatically interpretable.
items.mitigation: No XLSX parser was added; workbook files retain the native-application explanation. CSV/TSV and supported source documents remain inline. Only the two previously reviewed BASS equation figures are currently plotted entries; the original-only graph is excluded and no arbitrary plot is digitized. Source curves use published rounded coefficients; hover decimals do not imply measurement precision or a fire-risk prediction. Preview-internal scrolling can only be retained up to the new content extent. The outer document and file controls remain stable. Browser uses the actual application/catalog and two TEST ONLY provider fixtures, not a live Gemini call. Clean second-machine and signing/SmartScreen verification remain open. The independent Astra/High third-party collection has its own manifest and is not automatically used as validated production model evidence. NASA core is preserved; NPR Class C remains an incomplete engineering target.

items.problem: The CSV adapter treated a sample/run inventory as an unsupported numerical table. It contains 122 inventory entries but no gravity, temperature, pressure or oxygen columns. The separate as-run workbook was not consumed.
items.mitigation: Add 121 row-specific pressure entries from the exact hash-pinned as run matrix sheet. Preserve file/sheet/cell/run/test/sample provenance and convert atm to kPa. Recompute all 67 pressure formula caches. Mark the CSV as an inventory rather than rejected measurements.

items.problem: A scenario-only subtotal such as 33.3 was displayed out of 100 even when all 60 condition points were unassessed. The detailed contribution list also displayed missing values as zero earned points.
items.mitigation: Show earned evidence points over the assessed budget, explicitly mark the overall comparison incomplete, exclude unassessed points from the displayed denominator and label missing contributions unassessed. Do not renormalize these points into a full percentage or change ranking weights.

items.problem: A text rewrite during this patch preserved CRLF bytes and added a second CR. The browser still parsed the module, but AST line numbers disagreed with the code-index line count. Package verification rejected the first candidate before distribution.
items.mitigation: Normalize the affected module to LF, rerun all 272 tests, rebuild and reverify the exact EXE, then regenerate and validate the source/block index. No scientific coefficients or UI behavior changed.

items.problem: The as-run worksheet oxygen header says percent by volume, while values such as 0.221 use a plain 0.000 display format. No numerical gravity or ambient temperature column exists there; AIR is an instrument display, often staged.
items.mitigation: Retain raw oxygen and AIR values without scoring or automatic scaling. Expose these limits in the source details and research context. Never manufacture numeric zero-g or 0.16 m/s2 from the ISS setting. Resolve units or acquire independent source evidence before enabling more fields.

items.problem: Only11 PSI investigations had partially normalized numerical rows. Several other studies had usable CSV settings, measured curve pressures or a graph header, but these were not available to the research scorer.
items.mitigation: Add81 reviewed fragments from9 exact-hash-pinned local source files:5 investigations add supported environmental fields and4 add material/fuel-stream/curve context. Separate scalar values, discrete sets, marginal spans, experimental curves, instrument capacities and outcomes. Do not pretend every source fragment is an individual trial.

items.problem: Environmental values could be credited across materials and material identity only affected a tie-break or warning. This was inconsistent with the requested material-specific source lookup.

items.problem: The target has approximately498MBRAM and4GBswap; concurrent context retrieval or repeated source hashing may exhaust memory or cause long delays.

items.problem: Anonymous cookie identity has no account recovery; history/cache files have no automatic retention policy. Cookie loss can strand history and growth can consume disk.
items.mitigation: Use HTTPS HttpOnly cookie and private0700state root/0600secret; explain server retention, monitor storage, and preserve signing secret during ordinary restart.

items.problem: Metadata readiness alone cannot establish complete remote dataset transfer or byte identity.

items.problem: IP certificate issuance/renewal failure or HTTP publication would break confidentiality for anonymous visitor credentials and conversations.

items.problem: Current conditions lost when asking for a study
items.rootCause: A whole-message source-word veto mistook discovery intent for source attribution.
items.fix: Recognize attributed sentences, preserving current measurements elsewhere; retain quote, hypothetical and range guards.

items.problem: Wrong physical quantity or material identity
items.rootCause: Gas percentages and specimen temperatures could collide with oxygen and ambient inputs; fuel vocabulary was incomplete and mixtures could lose their qualifier.
items.fix: Bind gas percentage and thickness to their local labels; exclude explicit nonambient temperatures; retain explicit composition and add named fuel aliases.

items.problem: Stale values after an explicit unknown
items.rootCause: An explicit unknown was treated like an absent field, preserving an old measurement.
items.fix: Clear that explicitly named current field and its basis; keep other fields unchanged.

items.problem: Different materials assembled into one numerical score
items.rootCause: With no user material, independent best values could come from different source materials.
items.fix: Select one identified source material family for parameter-wise comparison; show it; do not credit unidentified families. Align diagnostics to awarded references.

items.problem: Reused row identifiers implied a jointly tested tuple
items.rootCause: The joint-reference check used runId without source file identity.
items.fix: Require matching file identity, hash and runId, plus existing joint flags. Separate fragments remain separate.

items.problem: Partial evidence displayed as a headline 100 percent
items.rootCause: The card emphasized supported-input proximity instead of ranked points, hiding incomplete coverage.
items.fix: Display total earned points and assessed denominator first, supported-input count and conditional proximity second. Clarify Data / conditions reference wording.

items.problem: Close measured studies could miss the candidate shortlist
items.rootCause: Material candidates were ordered primarily by text overlap rather than indexed numerical evidence.
items.fix: Rank same-material candidates by parameter support before lexical tie breakers; retain content-retrieval slots and related-composite review.

items.problem: Numerical proximity remains a discovery heuristic, not a material-specific calibrated tolerance or burn-equivalence probability. Eight PSI records have no reviewed numeric case in this audit; this does not establish that their original documents lack data.
items.mitigation: Keep source coverage, provenance, nominal settings, material applicability and research usefulness visible. Do not manufacture missing measurements, calibration or live-model acceptance.
